notes.title: Demo released early!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45249474/ad6fbb627268f53591ae285ff1160f74b9e8bee8.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone,

When we announced the demo for [i]Adventures of a Cat in Space[/i], we originally intended to release the demo across all platforms on February 24th, to coincide with Steam's February Next Fest event.

We have since learned that some lucky people in the games industry press get exclusive access to all the games featured in Next Fest on 13th February!

Our demo has now been thoroughly tested, localised into five languages, and it's ready for an early launch, so we're pressing that big green "Release" button early to make the demo accessible to all those lovely, good-looking people in the press (who are hopefully reading this), and everyone else interested in playing it.

[b]We hope you enjoy the demo of [i]Adventures of a Cat in Space[/i], don't forget to add it to your wishlist![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3265960/Adventures_of_a_Cat_in_Space/

[b]The official website is available here:[/b] [url=https://catinspace.co.uk/]catinspace.co.uk[/url]
[b]Our press kit can be found here:[/b] [url=https://catinspace.co.uk/press]catinspace.co.uk/press[/url]

PR contact: [url=mailto:games@littleseedsmusic.co.uk]games@littleseedsmusic.co.uk[/url]

notes.title: Adventures of a Cat in Space is an upcoming musical adventure starring Arthur Darvill
notes.content:
Adventures of a Cat in Space sounds like an exciting one to keep on your radar. An upcoming musical point and click adventure game starring Arthur Darvill (Doctor Who, Broadchurch, Legends of Tomorrow and more).

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/01/adventures-of-a-cat-in-space-is-an-upcoming-musical-adventure-starring-arthur-darvill/

notes.title: Next Fest 2025 watch the developers play
notes.content: Join developer & artist Tom Hardwidge (Tall Story Games) and composer David Gibb (Little Seeds Music) as they play through the demo for Adventures of a Cat in Space and chat about the behind-the-scenes process, the game and the music.
